findings.issue: Resolve runs `git rev-parse --verify --quiet --end-of-options`; gitcontext's explicit-base path did not use --end-of-options before. rev-parse accepts it only from git 2.30; older git exits 1 silently under --quiet.
findings.consequence: On git < 2.30 every explicit --base in review/status/record-lenses fails with a misleading 'invalid git base' (ref is already validated not to start with '-').

findings.issue: A branch --base now requires merge-base(HEAD, ref); a shallow checkout has none, and the error does not say the clone is shallow.
findings.consequence: CI with default fetch-depth passing --base origin/main now fails with 'has no merge base with HEAD' instead of a hint to fetch full history (reproduced).

findings.issue: AC-3.6 (pre-#175 markers still match when the resolved SHA equals the recorded one) has no named test.
findings.consequence: The definition of done requires each AC proved by a named test; a later change matching on requestedBase would not be flagged.

findings.issue: The committed Markdown context packs (pr-ready/task-done/epic-ready print only '- Base: <sha>') and the learn post-merge run record do not record the requested base, though #175 says review logs record both.
findings.consequence: Committed review artifacts cannot show what --base was typed; audits must consult local uncommitted runs.jsonl.

findings.issue: New InitData field requested_base is written to the audit init event; older binaries decode init with DisallowUnknownFields.
findings.consequence: Reproduced: a run created by the new binary with --base returns ERR_AUDIT_INVALID from an older binary's fsm state/export in mixed-version setups.

findings.issue: 'pre-#175 markers keep matching on their SHA' holds only when main has not advanced; an old --base main marker stored main's tip and no longer matches once main moved.
findings.consequence: Operators may expect old markers to keep satisfying the gate after upgrade.

findings.issue: The internal/baseref import sits inside the stdlib import group.
findings.consequence: goimports/gci will flag and rewrite it.

findings.issue: When a tag and a branch share a short name, rev-parse returns the tag's commit (refs/tags precedes refs/heads) but isBranch is true, so the result is merge-base(HEAD, tag commit) — neither git's answer nor the branch's merge-base; the doc claims git's precedence.
findings.consequence: A repo with a tag named like a branch reviews against an unexpected base.

findings.issue: No test asserts RequestedBase on pr-ready run records (both sites) or the task-done record; deleting the assignments passes every test (mutation-verified).
findings.consequence: The audit field could silently disappear from pr-ready/task-done runs.jsonl rows.
